messages:
Rae - People Ops: Quick sync  New hire group arriving Wed 8:45. Need: 6 parking passes, two accessible desks, breakfast (2 GF, 2 vegan), badge pickup plan, and one hire with delayed passport for I-9. Can we allow them to start and complete I-9 after day 1? @LegalBot @Lina
Tom - Facilities: I can reserve 6 passes and mark the accessible desks. Shuttle OK at 8:30. Need attendee names by EOD.
Lina - IT: Laptops will be ready. Imaging window 8:50 or 9:20. Badge printer staffed until 10:00. Send emails for provisioning.
Rae - People Ops: Sending names now. The delayed passport hire expects it in 4 days. Is there a compliance workaround?
LegalBot: Reminder: I-9 must be completed within 3 business days. If passport delayed, acceptable alternatives may include combo of List A/B docs or authorized remote notarization with prior approval. Please DM case details to compliance@redwood.com for exception review.
Samira: Hiring manager asked if contractor can start with limited access while BG pending.
LegalBot: Contractors may be onboarded with restricted access pending BG if manager signs off and risk acknowledged. Document in Workday and notify security.
Rae - People Ops: Got it. I'll get the manager sign-off and submit to compliance. Catering: noted GF + vegan. Anything else?
Tom - Facilities: Passes sent. Security briefed to hold late badges until 10am.
PeopleOpsBot: Task created: wednesday-morning-onboard (#13579). Due: 2026-06-10.
Rae - People Ops: Thanks all  I'll confirm once compliance replies and close the checklist.
